contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), Urbs Roma commemorative issue of 330-340, Reece period 17, Trier mint issue of 330-340. Obverse description: Helmeted and mantled bust of Roma left. Obverse inscription: VRBS [ROMA]. Reverse description: Wolf suckling twins, two stars above; wreath between them. In exergue: TRS.
